description:
One building piece: costs, durability, siblings. The piece's `slug`, `display_name`, `grade`, `health` and `decay_hours`, plus `costs` (`build`, `repair`
and `upkeep` lists of `item_name`, `amount` or `min_amount`/`max_amount`, with `shortname`/`icon_url` when
the material maps to a catalogue item), `durability` (up to ten entries each for `explosive`, `melee` and
`bullet` damage: `item_name`, `seconds_taken` to destroy, `required_items` = how many of that weapon/explosive)
and `siblings` - the same piece at every other grade, Twig to Armored. Cached for one hour.
name: get_building_piece
title: One building piece: costs, durability, siblings
